plugins.name: what-next
plugins.description: Split open work into agent and human lanes with consistent action IDs, concrete tool calls, and evidence for each human gap.

plugins.name: htmlify
plugins.description: Turn dense Markdown into source-checked HTML timelines, decision surfaces, system explainers, visual progressions, evidence reviews, or deterministic formal HTML with optional PDF export.

plugins.name: replx
plugins.description: Drive a failing build, test, lint, or health check to a success condition you declare, in bounded iterations. The condition can be stated in prose, so a goal the command does not measure is still a valid target, and the protocol refuses the repairs that make a command pass without fixing the defect.

plugins.name: lint
plugins.description: Check or apply canonical formatting across mixed-language repositories with a read-only default.

plugins.name: agent-usage
plugins.description: Read how much of each AI provider's usage limit is left, when it resets, and which provider still has headroom. Answers from measured readings and declines when it cannot: a provider that did not respond is reported as not responding, never as zero usage, and a forecast with too little history returns a reason instead of a number.

plugins.name: swe-day
plugins.description: Run one self-contained SWE day of work end to end, with a human gate at every judgment call and a hard rule that the agent never pushes to the shared repo.

plugins.name: gitchat
plugins.description: Exchange agent messages through Git branches on a shared remote: one side sends a prompt, the other polls for it and pushes back a response.

plugins.name: m2
plugins.description: Reference text for m2, a manager-of-managers protocol for coding agents. Four protocol documents and no runnable code.

plugins.name: swe-it
plugins.description: Turn an approved implementation plan into a JSON execution contract and a dispatch prompt for a swe-day, multi-swe-day or m2 run, with a needs_human stop and a clean-HEAD verifier.

plugins.name: extended-adversarial-code-review
plugins.description: Decide whether a multi-round adversarial code review is worth running, shape each round so it terminates, and evaluate a checkable stopping rule from the per-round yield.

plugins.name: multi-swe-day
plugins.description: Instructions and helper programs for splitting software work across a leader chat, builder chats and an auditor chat over gitchat. The lane registry refuses overlapping lanes.
